name: Movement on Your Turn
description: Move up to your speed on your turn; you may split movement before and after actions.

name: Difficult Terrain
description: Every foot of movement in difficult terrain costs one extra foot.

name: Standing Up
description: Standing from prone costs movement equal to half your speed.

name: Climbing Swimming Crawling
description: Each foot costs one extra foot of movement unless a relevant special speed applies.

name: Jumping
description: Long jump with a running start covers up to Strength score in feet; high jump with a running start reaches 3 + Strength modifier feet, minimum 0. Halve distances without 10-foot run-up.

name: Variant Encumbrance
description: If carrying weight exceeds 5 times Strength score (in pounds), speed drops 10 feet; if it exceeds 10 times Strength score, speed drops 20 feet and the character has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls and saving throws using Strength, Dexterity or Constitution.
